purpose: MoveIt이 무엇인지 소개하는 개념 설명용 그림. 실제 로봇 동작 검증 자료가 아닙니다.
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a polished premium editorial 3D illustration for a Korean robotics concept blog, comprehensible at elementary-school level but visually sophisticated, warm ivory and muted rose/copper palette. Simple cream industrial articulated robot arm with three clearly visible circular joints and a two-finger gripper, rose joint inserts, on a compact plinth. Warm off-white seamless background #f7f0e7, soft studio lighting, restrained realistic bevels and materials, gentle contact shadows, generous negative space, landscape composition about 3:2. No text, labels, numbers, logos, faces, decorative UI, wires or extra robots. Make the actual robot coherent, with rigid connected links and plausible joints. Subject: show what a target pose means. One robot arm at left-middle is reaching toward one small rose ceramic cup at right on a low block. The cup is not held. A single very faint ghost silhouette of ONLY the gripper at the goal beside the cup, linked by a subtle dotted rose guide, helps a child see where the hand wants to go. Keep the main robot and cup large and readable on a phone. No obstacle in this image.

relatedAssets.purpose: 모션 플래닝을 소개하는 두 번째 화면의 설명용 그림. 점선은 손끝 이동을 직관적으로 보여주는 시각적 비유입니다.
